def test_column_sum_contradiction():
    df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3]})
    total = df["a"].sum()

import pandas as pd


def test_column_sum_is_six():
    df = pd.DataFrame({"a": [1, 2, 3]})
    total = df["a"].sum()
    assert total == 6
